gloss: passing score; passing grade; passing mark

definitions.explanation: The minimum score required to pass an examination or test.
Used figuratively to describe a satisfactory or acceptable standard of quality or performance.

examples.japanese: {合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七十点|ななじゅってん}だ。
あと{五点|ごてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}かなかった→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: I fell short of the passing score by just five points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おいた⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The passing score changes every year, so you should check past data.

⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合格点|ごうかくてん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ほしい。
examples.english: The taste of the food is acceptable, but the presentation could be a little better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧にして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげられる→あげる：00546_ageru⟧⟦{出来栄|できば}え→出来栄え：09045_dekibae⟧だった。
examples.english: For a first attempt, the result was good enough to get a passing mark.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧ (passing; success) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (score; point). In its literal sense, it refers to the cutoff score on exams. In everyday conversation, it is often used figuratively to evaluate things like food, performance, or work quality, meaning "good enough" or "acceptable."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the passing score
- {合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to fall short of the passing score
- {合格点|ごうかくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげる→あげる：00546_ageru⟧: to give a passing mark (figurative)
- {合格点|ごうかくてん}ギリギリ: barely passing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{及第点|きゅうだいてん}→及第点：15356_kyuudaiten⟧: passing mark — more formal and literary; also used figuratively
- ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧ライン: passing line — often used for the borderline score in competitive entrance exams
